status: REGISTERED before data collection; executes only after the native reliability study reports
question: What distance, survival and pace do explicit non-learning controls achieve on the actual game under the Cycle 2 episode lifecycle, so that learned policies have matched comparators?
upgrades: recorded from the Tune or vehicle screen at session start; expected 13/13, 14/14, 16/16, 10/10

policies.random: uniform over the four joint pedal states each decision; learner RNG seed 5201

stabilizing.definition: gas when the body is level and grounded; coast (neutral) when the body pitch magnitude exceeds the threshold or when airborne; brake is never used
stabilizing.pitch_source: 0.5 * atan2(body_sin_2angle, body_cos_2angle) from the screen bridge (image axis modulo pi; sign convention not required)
stabilizing.airborne_rule: detect_airtime_events criterion on the current frame: both wheel clearances valid and above max(0.15 axles, 1.6 x wheel radius); unknown wheel state counts as grounded
stabilizing.fallback: gas when body pitch is unavailable; neutral when the required body features are missing
stabilizing.parameters_chosen: a priori from Cycle 1 measurement units, before any Cycle 2 baseline or learned data; never tuned on evaluation episodes

schedule: interleaved order random, always_gas, stabilizing repeated; 10 completed attempts per policy targeted; sessions of at most 12 attempts

score_readers.coins: hud-coin-counter-2.0 on the first and last playing frames (exploratory until validated)
score_readers.fuel: hud-fuel-gauge-2.0 on the last playing frame (exploratory until validated)

outcome_vector: behavioral-metrics-2.0 per attempt: distance with source, terminal cause, survival of the horizon, gameplay and session seconds, reset and advertisement overhead, HUD coverage, time to reach 100/250/500 m, stagnation, airtime events, coin boundary readings
statistics: per policy: n, mean, median, std, p05/p25/p75/p95, episode percentile bootstrap CI (conditional on the scripted policy); survival fraction with exact binomial interval; terminal cause counts; scored versus excluded attempts
exclusion_rules: none after the fact; unscored attempts are reported as unknown distance and excluded only from distance statistics with their count shown
missingness_rules: unknown scores stay unknown; a halted session reports remaining scheduled attempts as not_attempted
success_criteria: descriptive study; it succeeds when every policy has at least 10 completed scored attempts or the six-session budget is exhausted with all attempts classified
